title: Clean Code Myths Hurting Your Velocity

beats.voice: Most developers treat clean code rules like dogma, and it quietly destroys their shipping speed.

beats.before: Every class needs an interface and five layers of abstraction
beats.after: Write simple direct functions until you actually need two implementations
beats.voice: You don't need interfaces and five abstraction layers for single-use internal logic.

beats.caption: The Rule of 3|Duplicate once before abstracting|Refactor when patterns emerge
beats.voice: Follow the rule of three: write straightforward code first, and extract abstractions only when patterns repeat.

beats.hook: Readability beats cleverness every single time
beats.voice: Remember: readability beats clever abstractions every single time.
